title: PCA in three dimensions: the plane that keeps the most spread

objects.text: PCA in 3D: find the plane, drop the rest

say.en: Six points in three dimensions. We want the flat plane that keeps as much of their spread as possible, so we can drop one coordinate.
say.te: Three dimensions లో six points. వాటి spread ని maximum గా keep చేసే flat plane కావాలి, అప్పుడు one coordinate ని drop చేయవచ్చు.

say.en: Here they are: A at 3, 2, 1, B opposite it, C and D, and the two small ones E and F.
say.te: ఇవే points: A at 3, 2, 1, దానికి opposite గా B, C and D, మరియు two small ones E and F.

say.en: Step one: spread is measured from the mean, so we find it. The x values add to zero, and so do y and z; the mean is the origin.
say.te: Step one: spread ని mean నుంచి measure చేస్తాం, కాబట్టి mean find చేస్తాం. x values add చేస్తే zero, y and z కూడా zero; mean is the origin.

say.en: That is convenient: the centred data is the data itself, so every number below uses the coordinates as they stand.
say.te: ఇది convenient: centred data అంటే data itself, కాబట్టి below ఉన్న every number coordinates ని as they stand use చేస్తుంది.

say.en: Step two: the covariance matrix. Each entry is a sum of products divided by n minus one, which is five.
say.te: Step two: covariance matrix. Each entry అంటే products యొక్క sum ని n minus one తో divide చేస్తాం, అది five.

say.en: The variance of x: nine plus nine plus four plus four plus one plus one is twenty-eight, over five is 5.6.
say.te: x యొక్క variance: nine plus nine plus four plus four plus one plus one is twenty-eight, over five is 5.6.

say.en: The covariance of x and y: the products are six, six, six, six, minus one, minus one, which sum to twenty-two, over five is 4.4.
say.te: x and y యొక్క covariance: products are six, six, six, six, minus one, minus one, sum is twenty-two, over five is 4.4.

say.en: The same rule gives the rest. The matrix is symmetric: the entry for x and y equals the entry for y and x.
say.te: Same rule తో rest వస్తాయి. Matrix symmetric: x and y entry, y and x entry తో equal.

say.en: Step three: the directions of greatest spread are the eigenvectors of C, and the spread along each is its eigenvalue. We solve the characteristic equation.
say.te: Step three: greatest spread ఉన్న directions అంటే C యొక్క eigenvectors, each direction లో spread అంటే దాని eigenvalue. Characteristic equation solve చేస్తాం.

say.en: The roots are ten, 1.91 and 0.19. They add up to 12.1, the trace of C, which is a check worth doing in the exam.
say.te: Roots are ten, 1.91 and 0.19. వాటి sum 12.1, అది C యొక్క trace, exam లో చేయదగిన check.

say.en: The first eigenvector points along x equals y: that is the long diagonal the points lie on. Its arrow is drawn with length root ten.
say.te: First eigenvector x equals y direction లో ఉంటుంది: points ఉన్న long diagonal అదే. దాని arrow length root ten తో draw చేశాం.

say.en: The second is perpendicular to it and tilts out of the floor; the third is the leftover direction, with almost no spread.
say.te: Second దానికి perpendicular, floor నుంచి tilt అవుతుంది; third అంటే leftover direction, almost no spread.

say.en: Step four: the first two eigenvectors span a plane. That plane is where we keep the data.
say.te: Step four: first two eigenvectors ఒక plane ని span చేస్తాయి. ఆ plane లోనే data ని keep చేస్తాం.

say.en: Each point drops onto the plane along the third direction. The drop line is the part we throw away: its length is the point's coordinate along PC3.
say.te: Each point third direction along plane మీదకు drop అవుతుంది. Drop line అంటే మనం throw away చేసే part: దాని length point యొక్క PC3 coordinate.

say.en: For A, that coordinate is minus 0.45 times 3, plus 0.45 times 2, plus 0.77 times 1, which is 0.31. Small, as it should be.
say.te: A కోసం ఆ coordinate minus 0.45 times 3, plus 0.45 times 2, plus 0.77 times 1, అంటే 0.31. Small, as it should be.

say.en: Now look straight down PC3. The plane faces us, the drop lines vanish, and the six points become a flat picture with two coordinates each.
say.te: ఇప్పుడు PC3 along straight గా చూద్దాం. Plane మన వైపు face అవుతుంది, drop lines vanish అవుతాయి, six points two coordinates తో flat picture అవుతాయి.

say.en: Step five: how much did we keep? The two eigenvalues we kept add to 11.91 out of 12.1: 98.4 percent of the spread, with one coordinate fewer.
say.te: Step five: ఎంత keep చేశాం? Keep చేసిన two eigenvalues 11.91 out of 12.1: spread లో 98.4 percent, one coordinate fewer తో.

say.en: That is PCA in three dimensions: centre, covariance, eigenvectors, project onto the top ones, and report the variance kept.
say.te: ఇదే three dimensions లో PCA: centre, covariance, eigenvectors, top ones మీదకు project, variance kept report.
